description.p: Collabora Office brings the familiar Collabora Online experience to your computer - so you can create, edit, and present with a beautiful, modern UI. It delivers excellent interoperability with ODF and Microsoft Office formats (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), and exports to PDF with ease. Your documents stay on your device unless you choose to share them - privacy by design.
New features and fixes in this release:

ul.li: Open documents from Nextcloud and OpenCloud servers straight from the start screen, and save them back - switching to real-time collaboration when someone else joins
A refreshed start screen with introductory documents, better templates handling, and Recent files that keep up with Save As
Multi-monitor presenting fixes, videos that start with their slide, and animated GIFs in Impress and Draw
New in Calc: Principal Component Analysis, the ARRAYTOTEXT and MSVD functions, spilled-range references, and Text to Column
Copy and paste as Markdown in Writer, Calc and Impress
The AI assistant now builds whole presentations - it proposes an outline you can edit, then lays it out on a design template of your choice
Maximize the Impress slide panel into a grid of large thumbnails, reorder slides by dragging, and rename sections in place
Settings that persist, sharper cursors on HiDPI screens, and automatic dark mode following your desktop
A broad set of accessibility improvements: keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, and focus and contrast fixes throughout
All fixes and improvements from the shared codebase with Collabora Online 26.04.3.3, including many document compatibility fixes for Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint files

description.p: New features and fixes in this release:

ul.li: Built-in AI assistant across Writer, Calc and Impress – draft and refine text, fix formulas, fact check slides, without leaving your work

Ever improving document compatibility – improved handling of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint formats
More accessible – a broad set of accessibility improvements throughout
More reliable clipboard – copy and paste in and out of Collabora Office
